rows.label: tlk70000033_01_msg0001
rows.name:
Did you know, mo? There's a splendid
garden on the other side of this moat,
mo.

rows.label: tlk70000033_01_msg0002
rows.name:
And in one corner is a very tall
lookout tower. The view from there is
said to be spectacular, mo!

rows.label: tlk70000033_01_msg0003
rows.name:
Momimi knows it's bad, but standing
somewhere that high gets Momimi so
excited she wants to jump, mo.

rows.label: tlk70000033_01_msg0004
rows.name:
And who knows? You might reach roofs,
behind buildings, or other unexpected
places, mo.

rows.label: tlk70000033_01_msg0005
rows.name:
But a fall would really hurt, so don't
jump, mo. Got it? Absolutely don't
jump, mo.
